label: FACIS DSP — IAM Verify
info:
NF-1 / FR-IAM-001 / FR-IAM-002 shared verifier. Reached via `link call`
from tab-dsp-negotiations and tab-dsp-transfers (NOT the fire-and-forget
`link out`/`link in` idiom used by dsp.persist.* — this needs a result back,
which only `link call` + `link in [return]` provide).

DSP_IAM_ENFORCE=off|warn|enforce (default enforce):
  off     — always returns msg.identity=null, msg.iamRejected=false (parity
            mode; callers must fall back to their pre-NF-1 behaviour).
  warn    — verification runs and failures are logged, but msg.iamRejected
            is always false (never blocks a request).
  enforce — failures set msg.iamRejected=true + a DSP-shaped 401.

VP holder DID resolution (dsp-iam-prep → dsp-iam-resolve-did →
dsp-iam-verify-vp) and VC issuer DID resolution (dsp-iam-verify-vp →
dsp-iam-resolve-vc-did → dsp-iam-verify-vc) both go through a real
Node-RED `http request` node — function nodes never call the raw fetch
API directly, since the function-node vm sandbox does not expose it.

See orce/tests/flows/iam-verify.spec.js / iam-verify-golden.spec.js for the
mirrored pure logic this tab's function nodes must stay byte-identical to.

name: prep + cache check
verify VP + policy (thru VC decode)
verify VC signature
verify status list + check bit
